title: Egnyte: enterprise file summaries and collaboration in Teams
availability: Coming soon, explicitly stated by Microsoft at retrieval
overview: Microsoft's Egnyte entry describes scanning files in Egnyte storage, summarizing or generating content and collaborating in Teams conversations. The integration is explicitly marked coming soon, so this is a published planned workflow rather than a verified deployed customer case.
published_facts: The described agent scans files in Egnyte storage to summarize or generate content.
Users collaborate on that content in Teams one-to-one and group conversations.
Microsoft explicitly marks the Egnyte Agent 365 integration as coming soon.

sources.title: Ecosystem partner agents available in Agent 365 - Egnyte
sources.verification: Primary page and Egnyte section fetched and read directly, including availability caveat.

a365_relationship: Direct but planned: Microsoft explicitly names the integration and says it is coming soon.
intent: Read the relevant enterprise files, summarize their content and share the summary in the intended Teams conversation.
actors: Employee, Egnyte content agent and conversation participants; abstract Agent role.
published_outcome: Published intended content collaboration behavior; current availability and customer results are not verified.

actions.description: Scan the relevant files in Egnyte storage.
Share the summary in the intended Teams conversation.

local_assumptions: The declared environment assumes file access and Teams presentation capabilities for testing; it does not claim the planned integration is live.
The runtime source fixture represents an immutable snapshot or manifest of all contributing files, not an actual Egnyte folder.
Independent approval and an exact conversation allowlist are added local safeguards.
limitations: The planned integration's live availability is unverified.
The host must bind all contributing source versions; SkillC cannot detect an unseen remote file change.
Summary fidelity, legal privilege, document classification and effective file permissions need additional systems.

runtime_model.source_fixture: Synthetic immutable manifest of source files and versions.
